newsitem.title: UK: ICI shares edge up after broker comments.
newsitem.headline: ICI shares edge up after broker comments.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc (ICI) edged up on Wednesday as SBC Warburg restated a "buy" recommendation on the stock but analysts at Salomon Brothers downgraded the share to a "hold" from a "buy".
ICI shares were up one penny at 753p by 1207 GMT.
Market sources said analysts at SBC Warburg had given a 12-month price target of 840p for the stock.
But Salomon Brothers cut its price target to 780p, analyst Leslie Chow said.
"We've reviewed the (ICI) 1996 results and we found them disappointing," Chow said. "We've downgraded our 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates. Both have been cut by nearly 20 percent."
Chow said Salomon expected flat ICI earnings during 1997. "We no longer see the shares as a buy," he added.
